data.desc: Founded in 1887, Farmers National Banc Corp. is a diversified financial services company headquartered in Canfield, Ohio, with $7.1 billion in banking assets. Farmers National Banc Corp.'s wholly owned subsidiaries are comprised of The Farmers National Bank of Canfield, a full-service national bank engaged in commercial and retail banking with 80 banking locations in Ohio and western Pennsylvania, and Farmers Trust Company, which operates trust offices and offers services in the same geographic markets. Total wealth management assets under care at June 30, 2026, are $5.1 billion. Farmers National Insurance LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of The Farmers National Bank of Canfield, offers a variety of insurance products.
